todo: The prior depressive-disorder suggestion was withdrawn because the cited systematic review supports a modest population-level association and a small incident-depression signal but does not establish that gout causes or aggravates an individual depressive disorder; its conclusion specifically calls for further research on mental-disorder onset after gout diagnosis.
